title: HELLO-FULL: the unmodified picocalc_helloworld passes end to end, deterministically

backend_commit.note: Runs were made with the PWM observation accessor applied on top of 7db1945; that change is committed as ba66390.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Attach an 8 MiB PSRAM model to PIO1, DMA and GP20/21/2/3
hello_full_conditions.evidence: picocalc-board wires picoem-devices::Psram to CS20/SCK21/MOSI2/MISO3 on PIO1; the firmware's own DMA feeds the PIO TX FIFO.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Run the sample's full 8/16/32/128-bit write and read test without reducing its range
hello_full_conditions.evidence: All nine UART result lines are present, covering every width and both write paths plus read-back.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Capture the PSRAM completion result from UART or LCD, with zero mismatches
hello_full_conditions.evidence: 'PSRAM testing done' on both UART and the display; independent range verification reports 8388608 matched and 0 mismatched.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Handle battery and backlight registers on the address 0x1f keyboard controller
hello_full_conditions.evidence: Display reads 'battery percent is 100' and 'battery is not charging'; four backlight levels are written and read back without error.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Scripted keys reach the FIFO and are echoed to the LCD
hello_full_conditions.evidence: --keys HI queued two press/release pairs; all four events were delivered and both characters render on the last line of the framebuffer.

hello_full_conditions.condition: PWM initialisation is observable; audible output is not required because main() never starts playback
hello_full_conditions.evidence: One configured slice reported: slice 5 (the pair carrying GP26/GP27), CSR enable set, TOP 250. No sample stream is started by the firmware and none is modelled.

hello_full_conditions.condition: No unsupported MMIO, bus fault, panic or silently dropped peripheral
hello_full_conditions.evidence: unsupported_mmio empty, exception null, stop_reason cycle_limit — the run ends because the budget is spent, not because anything failed.

hello_full_conditions.condition: Save UART log, framebuffer, key result, PSRAM result, backend/source commit and artefact SHA-256 to structured artefacts, and get the same result across repeated runs
hello_full_conditions.evidence: Three consecutive runs produced byte-identical UART (607 bytes) and PNG files, and JSON reports that differ only in the PNG filename each run was told to write.

determinism.note: The only JSON difference across runs is the framebuffer.png field, which echoes the output path given on the command line. That is an input, not emulator state.

declaration: With all eight conditions met, the official picocalc_helloworld is judged to run on the emulator. This is the point EMULATOR_ROADMAP reserves that statement for.
known_limitations: Timing is not calibrated against silicon; the firmware's own microsecond figures are emulator time, not device time.
PWM playback, SPI0 SD and core 1 remain unmodelled — none is exercised by this target. See firmware-validation/capability.json.
The threaded execution model still carries the sub-quantum edge-loss and WFE wake gaps that were fixed on the Serial path.
